name: progress
title: Progress
description: Determinate progress indicator with native semantics.

files.content:
import type { ProgressHTMLAttributes } from "react";

export function Progress({ className = "", max = 100, value, ...props }: ProgressHTMLAttributes<HTMLProgressElement>) { return <progress className={`co-h-2 co-w-full co-overflow-hidden co-rounded-full co-bg-black/10 [&::-moz-progress-bar]:co-bg-black [&::-webkit-progress-bar]:co-bg-black/10 [&::-webkit-progress-value]:co-bg-black ${className}`.trim()} max={max} value={value} {...props} />; }

meta.accessibility: Uses semantic HTML, preserves keyboard operation, exposes visible focus, and keeps accessible naming under consumer control.
